screening_decisions.reason: Not a randomised controlled trial; this is a paper describing FIGO staging revisions, with no intervention comparison.
RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens (doxorubicin vs doxorubicin+cyclophosphamide) in advanced/recurrent endometrial carcinoma; meets all inclusion criteria.

Phase III RCT comparing two chemotherapy combinations in endometrial carcinoma; although abstract does not explicitly state ‘advanced’, typical GOG phase III trials of this kind enrol advanced/recurrent patients. No indication of adjuvant setting. Include conservatively.
Methodology paper on standardizing outcome reporting; not an RCT of chemotherapy.
Retrospective case series of surgical treatment (pelvic exenteration); not an RCT, and no chemotherapy intervention.
RCT comparing two chemotherapy agents (adriamycin vs cyclophosphamide) in advanced endometrial cancer; meets inclusion criteria.
Randomized phase II trial comparing cisplatin vs CAP chemotherapy in advanced, progestin-refractory endometrial carcinoma; qualifies as an RCT of chemotherapy in advanced disease.
Randomized phase II trial comparing cyclophosphamide vs ifosfamide in advanced/recurrent endometrial adenocarcinoma; meets RCT and population criteria.
Completely off-topic: review of beta blockers in myocardial infarction, not endometrial cancer and not a primary RCT.
RCT (all but a small subgroup randomised) comparing two multi-agent chemotherapy regimens in advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer; meets inclusion criteria.
Methodology paper about meta-analysis of survival data; not an RCT or primary study.
Phase III RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens (MVAC vs AC) in advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer; meets inclusion criteria.
Phase III RCT comparing two chemotherapy combinations (AP vs TAP) in advanced endometrial carcinoma; clearly meets inclusion criteria.
Study population is non-small-cell lung cancer, not endometrial cancer; completely unrelated disease.

Comparative study of three combination chemotherapy regimens in advanced uterine corpus carcinoma, but no mention of randomisation in abstract; likely non-randomised. Does not meet the RCT requirement.
Methodology paper providing guidance for meta-analysis of time-to-event data; not a clinical trial.
Short commentary/citation; no original study data, not an RCT.
Cochrane review on adjuvant chemotherapy; even if it includes RCTs, the topic is adjuvant treatment, which is explicitly excluded per protocol.
Cochrane review of hormonal therapy, not chemotherapy; no chemotherapy arm and not a primary RCT.
General overview/guideline article about endometrial cancer management; not an RCT.
Retrospective analysis of patient outcomes; not an RCT.
Phase III RCT comparing two schedules of the same chemotherapy (doxorubicin+cisplatin) in stage III/IV or recurrent endometrial carcinoma; meets chemotherapy RCT criteria.
Phase III RCT comparing doxorubicin vs doxorubicin+cisplatin in advanced endometrial carcinoma; clearly meets inclusion criteria.
RCT comparing doxorubicin vs doxorubicin+cisplatin in advanced/recurrent endometrial adenocarcinoma; meets all criteria.
